Initial commit.
Initial commit
Use mysql_real_escape() to get rid of some warnings.
Better debugging support for LDAP.
Handle WebKOS format used from 2017.
Allow for importing prepared sets of assignments in PDF format.
LectureBean::getCode() replaced with LectureBean::getCodeFromData().
New method LectureBean::code2url().

SessionDataBean::getLectureGroupFlag() renamed to getLectureGroupType.
Renamed also the getter method in LectureBean.
Delete old public directory `webdir`.
Update list of ignored files and directories.
Text update.
Display something when the list of students is empty.
Do not double index exerciseList[excPos].id, use exercise.id instead.

New app structure, `public` is now the visible part of the web.
Class autoloading.
Reflect renaming the base class to LectwebSmarty.

Updated for Smarty3.
Renamed CPPSmarty to LectwebSmarty.
Moved to Dibi database interface.
New function `removeDirContent()`
dbReplace() corrected.
Handle new WebKOS format as of 2017.

Import prepared assignments in PDF format, without the need for TeX sources.
Has to handle student groups properly as well.

New schoolyear 2018/2019 added with estimated dates.
Better description for OutOfRangeException.

Dropped lecture group flag in favor of lecture group type. This way we
can have different types of student groups.
Reformatted some comments.
Updated to reflex new file location (webdir -> public).
Comments upated.
Hard-coded implementation of exam points for lecture id 27 (11DOPM).

Ignore some files that are marked as ignored by PhpStorm, but Git does
not know about them.
Correct charset to UTF-8.
Ignore also the Dibi database connector library.
New AJAX handler. Mark or unmark the given lecturer as person related to the given lecture at this school year.
More file types to ignore.
Add .edit_success and .edit_fail to .admintable.
Reformatted.

LabtaskGroupSectionBean::getLabtasksForGroups(): Return active laboratory tasks and not completely all tasks that are defined for the lecture.
Corrected some typos in templates.
Use {foreach} instead of {section} in templates to facilitate nested loops. Needed for displaying multiple tutors per exercise.
Added schoolyear info for 2016/2017.

Keep a list of lecturers related to given lecture in every school year.
Select lecturers from this list as tutors for exercises.
Allow for multiple tutors at every exercise (also part of the commit where exercises have been renamed).
Templates: HTML tables of class .admintable need to override some defaults changes by bootstrap to display correctly with borders.

Corrected the long standing typo "excersisie" to "exercise". Changes also table names and table column names.
ExerciseBean, ExerciseRepBookingBean: Support multiple tutors per exercise.

Check for $info being null.
Set the implicit scaling coefficient to 10. for new students. KOS data do not contain anything on that matter.

Removed StudentBean::active property, it is not used anywhere.
New property StudentBean::coeff holding scaling coefficient for tests for students with disabilities.
Template changes.

CPPSmarty::locale is now private.
Use mysql_real_escape_string() rather than mysql_escape_string() even if it is deprecated.
Correct encoding for some error messages.
New method DatabaseBean::dbDeleteByIdList().

New methods.

Mostly just formatting changes.
Changed scope of some class variables (StudentBean, CPPSmarty), created the necessary getters and setters.

Use array_pad() to make sure that the "exploaded" $act value will always have three components.
Remove the trailing dot in the trigger_error() message when session expires.
Remove style and set zero margin and padding for GLOBAL_ALERT_FILE.

Check for existence of keys before using them in LoginBean::doVerify().
Small login template update to reflect not giving username when logging in.
Allow also "show file" action to circumvent the session expiration mechanism.
Missing title template added.
Redirect to base path in cases when session expires.
Consolidate  DatabaseBean::dbQuerySingle($alt_id=0) signatures to get rid of PHP Strict Standards warning.
Added {$global_alert} template variable defined as GLOBAL_ALERT_FILE in config.php.
Changes in formatting the points table to make it look like the the lecture table.

Code cleanup.

daynumToOffsets(): Compute correct offsets also for semester that starts in the middle of the week.
